guide.authorityBoundary: Help is explanatory and read-only. Execution, admission and activation remain subject to their normal authority and state checks.

glossary.lane: A mutable, leased line of work backed by a thin overlay.
glossary.snapshot: An immutable identity for one composed workspace state.
glossary.projection: A disposable native-filesystem view created for bounded editing or tooling.
glossary.receipt: A snapshot containing evidence from a bounded operation such as a test.
glossary.proposal: An exact tested task-lane head offered to an integration lane.
glossary.blessing: The accepted exact snapshot of an integration lane.
glossary.seal: A successor Temple package composed from a blessed integration snapshot.
glossary.admission: A signed, bounded authorization to activate a checked generation.

operations.summary: Compose bounded typed scientific derivation paths into proposal-only candidates with explicit assumptions,losses,evidence and rejection receipts. No entailment,empirical authority,corpus admission or application activation.
Read a host-resolved local context at an exact state and interpretation. Does not grant authority or start services.
Prepare an algebra-first work commit using one exact immutable-snapshot,hash-bound prior capability observation. No application activation,deployment or business authority.
Legacy bounded inert-JSON preparation session. Use v2 for status,cancel and explicit limits.

Stage,inspect or cancel bounded inert JSON chunks by exact sequence and hash,then invoke observed algebra preparation after exact aggregate reassembly. Send at most 100000 characters per append;status never returns staged payload bytes. No supplied code execution or application authority.
Load the fixed SQLite-backed Claimipedia project declarations and inspect authored contexts using existing owners. Read-only; not application runtime extension loading or admission.
Read the fixed SQLite-captured Claimipedia operator corpus with exact source identity. Not a live application, public projection, mutation or admission.
Owned SQLite-backed application read projection lifecycle. Explicit captured sources and resource limits;no business mutation or application-author grant.
Inspect, initialize, prepare, admit and select exact reader-registry successors in SQLite. Does not activate a runtime or grant business authority.
Start, inspect, stop or select an exact SQLite-published work context. Selection grants no product activation or new authority.

Return the current Sourcery MCP surface and connection interaction context. List returns filters and pagination immediately; select binds a workspace for subsequent Status. Context selection does not acquire a writer lease.
Legacy governed create-only runtime installation and qualification. Use temple_runtime_package_v2 for bounded resumable authoring. No activation or launcher modification.

Governed create-only runtime installation,qualification and resumable work preparation. prepare-session requires phase and session;status and cancel are bounded lifecycle actions. Exact SQLite package,discovery,review and installation admission required. No activation or launcher modification.

Governed create-only runtime installation,qualification and resumable work preparation. Phase-specific session arguments are schema-visible;status and cancel are bounded lifecycle actions. No activation or launcher modification.
Inspect or explicitly admit a changed inactive runtime-package review. Signed expiring eligibility only;no installation,activation or business authority.
Atomically activate an admitted generation after rechecking its exact bytes and baseline schema.
preconditions: The admission basis is still current.
Exact generation bytes and baseline compatibility still hold.
effects: Atomically activates the admitted generation.
Retains the predecessor for recovery.

operations.summary: Sign an explicit bounded admission for a passing check against the current generation.
preconditions: The check passed against the currently active generation.
effects: Creates a signed bounded admission.
Does not activate the generation.

operations.summary: Execute protected-runtime, transport and baseline-schema checks for a staged generation.
preconditions: The generation is staged.
effects: Checks protected runtime bytes, transport initialization and baseline schema compatibility.
Creates signed check evidence.

operations.summary: Describe the active fossil/runtime generation, retained transition evidence, compact workflows and operation catalogue.
effects: Returns active generation identity, transition evidence, workflows and an operation catalogue.

operations.summary: Describe any operation in the active worker catalog, including successor-only operations.
effects: Returns the live descriptor for a known active worker operation.

operations.summary: Execute an operation from the active worker catalog through the stable extension surface.
preconditions: operationId is present in the active worker catalogue.
The caller is authorized for the delegated operation.
effects: Delegates to the named active-generation operation; effects are those of that operation.

operations.summary: Return version-bound, read-only help for a Temple topic, operation or current lane context.
effects: Returns version-bound explanatory guidance.
Does not grant authority or execute another operation.

operations.summary: Create a signed recovery transition to the predecessor retained by an activation.
preconditions: The referenced activation successor is currently active.
The activation retained a predecessor.
effects: Rechecks, admits and activates the retained predecessor through a signed recovery transition.

operations.summary: Stage a named generation from the supervisor-controlled manifest directory.
preconditions: A controlled generation manifest and protected runtime package exist.
effects: Records the exact generation manifest after verifying protected runtime bytes.

operations.summary: Logically archive a closed lane with a terminal disposition; bytes are not deleted.
preconditions: The lane is closed.
A terminal disposition is supplied.
effects: Marks the lane archived.
Does not delete retained bytes.

operations.summary: Bless the exact tested head of an integration lane.
preconditions: The lane is an integration lane.
snapshotId is its exact current tested head.
effects: Moves the lane blessing to the exact snapshot.

operations.summary: Create a registered sparse editor projection inside the manager-controlled lane directory.
preconditions: The lane is open and snapshotId is its current head.
All editable paths are declared.
effects: Creates a registered sparse disposable projection.
Does not change the lane head.

operations.summary: Release one lane lease without an implicit commit.
preconditions: The caller holds the lane lease.
effects: Releases the lease.
Does not commit unrecorded filesystem changes.

operations.summary: Commit explicit changes to an open lane head.
preconditions: The lane is open and leased by the caller.
baseSnapshotId is the current lane head.
effects: Commits exactly the declared changes.
Advances the lane head to a new immutable snapshot.

operations.summary: Discard a registered editor projection and delete its disposable files without committing.
preconditions: The projection is registered to the lane.
effects: Deletes the disposable projection.
Does not commit projection changes.

operations.summary: Create a thin task lane from the exact blessed snapshot of a closed integration lane.
preconditions: The source is a closed integration lane.
sourceSnapshotId is its exact blessed snapshot.
effects: Creates a thin task lane and acquires its writer lease.

operations.summary: Renew an open lane writer lease.
preconditions: The caller holds the open lane lease.
effects: Renews the writer lease without changing the lane head.

operations.summary: Commit the exact delta from a disposable projection.
preconditions: The projection is based on snapshotId.
The lane head has not become stale.
effects: Commits the exact projection delta.
Advances the lane head.

operations.summary: List registered lanes without opening their overlay databases for writing.
effects: Returns registered lanes without opening overlays for writing.

operations.summary: List files in one open lane snapshot.
effects: Lists the immutable contents of the specified lane snapshot.

operations.summary: Create a disposable native projection for a filesystem-only tool.
preconditions: The target directory is permitted and suitable for a disposable projection.
effects: Creates a native-filesystem projection for a filesystem-only tool.
Does not change the lane head.

operations.summary: Merge a proposal from a registered source lane into an open integration lane.
preconditions: The target is an open integration lane.
The proposal belongs to the declared source task lane.
effects: Merges the proposed exact head into a new integration snapshot.

operations.summary: Create a fenced verified parallel successor lane on a new exact base without changing the source lane or reusing its snapshot identities.

Upload an exact workspace object in bounded hash-verified chunks or read it by bounded byte range. Each action declares its required arguments;object references are lane-and-snapshot bound and grant no authority.
Create or reopen a named task or integration lane and acquire its writer lease.
preconditions: The lane identifier is within the caller authority scope.
effects: Creates or reopens a lane and acquires its writer lease.

operations.summary: Apply algebra-prepared workspace changes as ordered,hash-bound,restart-safe segments. Phase-specific session arguments are schema-visible;commits occur once at finalize and responses remain compact.

Apply algebra-prepared workspace changes through bounded segments while binding a large capability prior by exact immutable workspace reference. Prior bytes are verified internally and never cross the MCP request envelope;old preparation contracts remain unchanged.
List registered editor projections and their durable disposition.
effects: Lists registered projections and their durable dispositions.

operations.summary: Propose the exact tested head of a task lane.
preconditions: The lane is a task lane.
Its exact current head has passing test evidence.
effects: Creates a proposal bound to that exact tested head.

operations.summary: Propose an exact tested task head with canonical artifact lineage and intended endpoints.
Read one file from an open lane composed view.
effects: Reads one file from the composed immutable snapshot.

operations.summary: Ingest the exact declared scope of a registered editor projection and delete its disposable files.
preconditions: The projection remains open and is based on the current head.
No undeclared paths were added.
effects: Commits the exact declared projection scope.
Advances the lane head.
Deletes the disposable projection after ingestion.

operations.summary: Compose a blessed integration lane into a successor Temple package.
preconditions: snapshotId is the integration lane blessing.
effects: Composes a successor Temple package at the controlled target.

operations.summary: Inspect one registered lane and its durable head/lease state.
effects: Returns lane, lease, head and blessing state without changing them.

operations.summary: Describe the exclusive writer ownership of one task lane without locking files or artifacts.
Run a bounded Node test in a disposable full, test-file or declared-closure projection and advance the lane head to its scope-bound receipt snapshot.
preconditions: The lane is open and snapshotId is its current head.
The selected projection contains the test and its required closure.
effects: Runs a bounded Node test.
Creates a scope-bound receipt snapshot whether the check passes or fails.
Advances the lane head to the receipt snapshot.

operations.summary: Run a bounded Node test in an explicitly selected disposable full, test-file or declared-closure projection and advance the lane head to its scope-bound telemetry receipt.

algebraFirst.scope: All Sourcery representation migrations use exact evidence. Static capabilities remain predecessors;new mature boundary capabilities enter through exact package-local declaration,qualification,grammar,phase,port,adapter and evidence closure.
algebraFirst.legacyCode: compatibility-only;unchanged use or deletion;extensions enter grammar

packageLocalCapabilities.extensionRule: new phases are package-local grammar data;new mechanisms remain explicit mature adapters

sequence: begin temple_workspace_prepare_session_v2 with exact work item,grammar fossil and capabilityPriorRef
upload large individual objects through temple_workspace_object_transfer
append ordered hash-bound change segments using inline values or object references

largeEnvelopeTransport.semantics: MCP carries bounded chunks,exact immutable references and compact hash-bound receipts;capability-prior and large object bytes remain server-side and are verified internally by lane,snapshot,path and object hash.
